company.name: RallyUp
company.body: I'm partner and chief of staff at RallyUp. We build LinkedIn audiences for B2B founders and executives: every post hand-written in their voice, engineered to reach the people who buy from them. In 2026 we've generated over 35 million impressions and created more than 750 posts for leadership teams at Airwallex, PandaDoc, Letter AI, Anchor Browser and 50+ other B2B tech brands.
